item.tib: tshe dbang mchog 'dus snyan rgyud rin chen sgron gsal gyi lag len
item.coloph: ces tshe dbang bod yul ma yi lag len thor tsam bkod pa po ni thos chung blun po btsun pa sa trig ming gis snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa sman ri ba'i rings (ring) lugs tshul bzhin 'chang ba sog dgon nor bu gling gi ri khrod du/ rang gi slob grogs phun tshogs rgyal mtshan gyis sgrab pa'i 'dun pa dang ldan kyang / sngon chad mkhan rin po che g.yung drung tshul khrims kyis mdzad pa'i zin bris grwa sar yod kyang / de skabs ma 'byor ba'i stabs kyis/ yul lugs kyi zin bris 'ga' mthong kyang (yang) / bdag blo g.yo sgra che stabs yid ston ma rnyed nas/ rang blo rmongs kyang dge tshul khrims bstan gyi zhal rgyun bzhin skabs tsam bkod pa dge/
